verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Working Copy has a built-in code view with syntax highlighting, SSH for git transport, and a JavaScript Console for runtime errors in previews. Nothing documents a terminal-based editor (such as vim or nano in a shell) or running syntax or lint checkers inside the app. The JS console and syntax highlighting are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can edit files with a terminal-based editor and run syntax/lint checkers inside the app
